rowType.description: "holiday" for one calendar day/event; "meta" for the single trailing summary row.

date.description: Gregorian date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD) of the event. Null on the meta row.

hebrewDateHe.description: Hebrew date in gematria, e.g. "א׳ בתשרי תשפ״ז".

category.description: One of: major, minor, fast, cholHamoed, modern, roshChodesh, omer, parasha, specialShabbat.

beginsEveningBefore.description: True when the observance begins at sunset the evening before the listed date (every Yom Tov and every major fast).

isYomTov.description: True for an actual Yom Tov day (work-restricted festival day, including Yom Kippur); false for Chol HaMoed, fasts, Rosh Chodesh, modern and minor days.

isIsraeliPublicHoliday.description: True for one of the nine statutory Israeli public-holiday days. Only set (non-null) when the run's location is "israel".

memo.description: Extra note, e.g. when a fast was deferred off Shabbat, or (meta row) a summary of the request.

hebrewYear.description: Hebrew year this row's date falls in.

isLeapYear.description: Whether hebrewYear has 13 months (Adar I + Adar II).

hebrewYearsInRange.description: Meta row only: every distinct Hebrew year touched by the requested year, each with isLeapYear and yearLength (days).
